description: Search active canonical places by text and optional geographic or type filters.

date.description: Optional historical date in yyyy-MM-dd format.

hasCoordinates.description: Optionally require places to have or not have coordinates.

latitude.description: Optional latitude in decimal degrees; longitude is required when supplied.

longitude.description: Optional longitude in decimal degrees; latitude is required when supplied.

query.description: Required place name or text to search for.

radiusKm.description: Optional positive search radius in kilometres; coordinates are required when supplied.

name: search_places
